steps: Add Xbox gamertag UncleVorath as a friend (auto-accepts within seconds).
Select UncleVorath under Joinable Friends to enter the NorthStar world.

in_world_commands_and_events.name: Fly a UFO Saucer
in_world_commands_and_events.description: Spawn and pilot a custom server-side UFO flying saucer across the world with zero client mods required.

in_world_commands_and_events.name: Safari Zoo Tour
in_world_commands_and_events.description: Visit the NorthStar Safari Zoo & Menagerie habitats.

in_world_commands_and_events.name: Warp boards
in_world_commands_and_events.usage: Two boards beside Arrival Plaza at (429, 65, -58) and (443, 65, -58). Press a button with an empty hand.
